verdict: Cost per lead dropped sharply, but volume is too thin to call it a trend.
narrative: This period you received 12 leads at an average cost of $197.76 per lead, with the Local Services campaign carrying the majority of paid spend. The week-over-week cost per lead fell 68% even as total spend was cut by 37%, which is an encouraging efficiency signal — but at only 12 leads over 28 days, the sample is too small to confirm that improvement is structural rather than a short-term fluctuation. Google Ads spend has been oscillating significantly day to day, and your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply in the most recent days in a way that paid changes alone don't fully explain; we're monitoring both closely. Next week we expect steadier Google delivery and are working to restore organic visibility on your profile.
